name: Disorienting Pulse
rulesText: Return chosen opposing unit in the Main Theater to its owner's hand.

name: Feed the Despoiler
rulesText:
As an additional cost to enact this maneuver, kill an allied unit.
Draw 2 cards.

name: Funeral Fungus
rulesText:
As an additional cost to enact this maneuver, exhaust a readied allied unit.
Return chosen unit card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Animoceps Spores
rulesText: Scratch 2, then return chosen allied Scratch Company unit to its owner's hand.

name: Conversion Spike
rulesText: Deal 1 damage to chosen opposing unit, and chosen allied unit or structure heals 1.

name: Deafening Aria
rulesText: Deal 1 damage to all opposing units in the Main Theater.

name: Ensnaring Mist
rulesText:
Move chosen unit to its controller's Reserves.
Chosen unit gets -1 power until end of turn.

name: Mutation Swell
rulesText: Kill 2 or 4 allied Scratch Company units. For every 2 units killed this way, deploy a unit card from your discard pile for free.

name: Rhapsody's Embrace
rulesText:
As an additional cost to enact this maneuver, kill an allied unit.
Kill chosen opposing unit.

name: Despoiler's Emergence
rulesText:
Deal 4 damage to all opposing assets in the Main Theater.
Deal 2 damage to all opposing non-Scratch assets in opponents' Reserves.

name: Forced Mutation
rulesText: Turn chosen opposing unit face down. It becomes a Scratch Company unit.

name: Rapturous Sermon
rulesText: Move all allied Scratch Company units to the Main Theater. Allied Scratch Company units get +2 power until end of turn.
